name: Taiwan Advanced Nanotech Inc.
summary: Taiwan Advanced Nanotech Inc. (TAN) specializes in the creation and manufacturing of products essential for isolating nucleic acids. The company's diverse range of offerings includes specialized reagent kits, which are utilized for extracting DNA and RNA from a wide array of biological specimens such as blood, cells, tissues, plants, bacteria, and viruses. TAN also supplies magnetic nanoparticles, specifically super-paramagnetic iron oxide and ultra-small super-paramagnetic iron oxide, designed for various molecular biology applications. Their product line extends to automated instruments for efficient genetic material extraction and crucial consumables like spin tips and deep well plates. These solutions are provided to public health agencies, diagnostic laboratories, hospitals, and other related clinical and research institutions. The company, established in 2004, operates out of Taoyuan, Taiwan.
